description: This file contains validation functions for various configuration parameters related to a 3GPP-based radio system, including PHY layer configurations, concurrency settings, and PRACH configurations.

methods.name: validate_upper_phy_threads_appconfig
methods.description: Validates upper PHY thread configuration parameters such as concurrency limits and processor type.

methods.name: validate_expert_execution_unit_config
methods.description: Validates execution unit configuration by checking thread settings.

methods.name: validate_phy_prach_configuration
methods.description: Validates PRACH configuration parameters for each cell.

methods.name: validate_expert_phy_unit_config
methods.description: Validates expert PHY unit configuration parameters like SINR calculation method and decoder iterations.

methods.name: validate_log_options
methods.description: Checks log configuration options, especially IQ dump settings.

methods.name: validate_du_low_config
methods.description: Main validation function that calls other validation functions for overall configuration validation.
